_doc: Schooling for the townsfolk's children (systems/townSchool.js). Kinds: parish (the priest teaches letters and scripture in the church or chapel), grammar (a schoolmaster, in towns and cities), tutor (at home, for the well-off), cloister (a few bright youths taught by the church for the clergy or the scribe's desk). Who goes: a share by the family's station (0 beggar … 3 noble) and the town's size, more where the school is funded; even-handed between girls and boys. Literacy (person.literacy, 0–100) grows each year at school; at 16 the home adds its bit; mailVoice reads it (writeAt). Fees are real coin from a parent's purse to the teacher's (the parish waives them for the poor and pays from the town's purse; a patron's fund pays first). Hours of a school day; no school every restEvery-th day.
